raw.overview: All advisors agree the packet reports 74.0% Day 90 retention, exceeding the 65% scale threshold, though Advisor 3 challenges the denominator calculation by including 400 pre-billing churners, suggesting the true retention may fall below 65% when accounting for all 1,400 activated users.
raw.points_of_note: Advisor 1 and 2 confirm 74.0% retention (740/1,000) based on a 1,000-user denominator excluding 400 pre-billing churners, satisfying the 65% constraint; Advisor 3 counters that including the 400 excluded users yields a 52.8% retention rate (740/1,400), creating a material constraint violation despite the headline metric appearing compliant.
raw.suggested_next_step: Verify whether the 65% retention threshold applies exclusively to users completing billing configuration (1,000 users) or all newly activated accounts (1,400 users) to resolve the denominator discrepancy before scaling.

consensus.text:
ASSESSMENT OVERVIEW: All advisors agree the packet reports 74.0% Day 90 retention, exceeding the 65% scale threshold, though Advisor 3 challenges the denominator calculation by including 400 pre-billing churners, suggesting the true retention may fall below 65% when accounting for all 1,400 activated users.
POINTS OF NOTE: Advisor 1 and 2 confirm 74.0% retention (740/1,000) based on a 1,000-user denominator excluding 400 pre-billing churners, satisfying the 65% constraint; Advisor 3 counters that including the 400 excluded users yields a 52.8% retention rate (740/1,400), creating a material constraint violation despite the headline metric appearing compliant.
SUGGESTED NEXT STEP: Verify whether the 65% retention threshold applies exclusively to users completing billing configuration (1,000 users) or all newly activated accounts (1,400 users) to resolve the denominator discrepancy before scaling.

shared_ground: Scale budget only if at least 65% of newly activated accounts remain active at Day 90
Retention metric must be based on newly activated accounts
